_note: Baseline SHA-256 digests of the upstream A2A artefacts we derive our Zod schemas from. Checked weekly by .github/workflows/spec-drift.yml — on drift an issue opens and a maintainer updates the Zod schemas + this file together. Since spec v1.0 upstream is proto-first: a2a.json is a generated artifact and no longer committed, so we track the canonical a2a.proto instead.

a2a-proto.description: Canonical A2A protocol definition (agent card, task, message, error codes).
